name: Sheng Yi Development Co.,Ltd
summary: Sheng Yi Development Co.,Ltd, an enterprise established in 1980 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, primarily functions as a real estate developer with operations spanning both its home country and international markets. The company's extensive activities also encompass the construction, leasing, and sale of residential properties. Furthermore, it provides decorating services, engages in the buying and selling of building materials, and manages property rentals. The firm adopted its current name in June 2017, having previously operated as Signality System Engineering Co., Ltd.
